transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As you all know, we have a preliminary-injunction hearing in three weeks, and I need to approve our response strategy before the motion papers are finalized. Before I sign off on anything, I need each of you to put your cards on the table. I want to hear about any material evidence we have — or don't have — any business constraints I should be aware of, and any proposed filing commitments you've been considering. Nothing surprises me on the day of a hearing. So let's go around the room. Who wants to start?
